_readme: Served by /api/app-config to the iPhone and Android apps. Raise `minimum` to make older apps ask people to update before they carry on (only for a broken or unsafe version). Raise `latest` after a store release so older apps offer an update. `store` stays empty until the app is live in that store. A `notice` (or null) shows once per id in the app. `features` turns online features off in every app without a new release.
